title: Register swim/dive in action_verbs.py and implement missing mount/dismount/ride handlers

sections.what: Close the half-wired traversal verbs gap by registering swim and dive in action_verbs.py / contextual-actions / PlanGrounding and implementing real dispatch handlers for mount, dismount, ride, and saddle.
sections.why: routes/action_handlers.py lists swim, dive, mount, dismount, ride, and saddle in _VERBS_NEEDING_TARGET (lines 139, 148), implements swim_to_area/dive_to_area (engine/movement.py:1123-1129), and maps ride -> Animal Handling in engine/traversal.py:63. Yet engine/action_verbs.py omits all six verbs, contextual-actions.ts only hints crawl/climb/jump, and mount/dismount/ride/saddle have zero handler branches so commands silently fall through to process_emote.
sections.how: 1. Register swim and dive in engine/action_verbs.py, add them to PlanGrounding.PLAN_INTENT_ACTS, and add swim/dive branches to way requirement hints in contextual-actions.ts (lines 350-355) alongside crawl/climb/jump.\n2. Implement mount / dismount / ride / saddle dispatch branches in routes/action_handlers.py and mounted-state helpers in engine/movement.py (reusing Animal Handling check from engine/traversal.py line 63, riding/vehicle entity tags, speed/carrying coupling, and clean dismount), and register them in engine/action_verbs.py so commands never fall through to process_emote.
sections.verify: 1. Run existing tests/test_swimming_and_diving.py plus new pytest coverage asserting swim, dive, mount, dismount, and ride resolve in ActionVerbs and /api/action.\n2. Run npm run build:ts and node tools/unit/run.cjs verifying PlanGrounding and contextual way hints recognize swim and dive.

acceptance.text: swim and dive are registered in engine/action_verbs.py, PlanGrounding, and contextual-actions way hints (matching routes/action_handlers.py lines 669-676 and engine/movement.py lines 1123-1129).
mount, dismount, ride, and saddle either execute real mounted state/movement behavior or fail with explicit informative errors rather than falling through to process_emote.

custom.browser_ui:
Intended UI home: Agent Turn Modal Available Actions / way movement hints (`contextual-actions.ts`) and Event Stream command output.

Current availability: routes/action_handlers.py lists swim, dive, mount, dismount, ride, and saddle in _VERBS_NEEDING_TARGET (lines 139, 148) and dispatches swim/dive (lines 669-676), while action_verbs.py omits all six and mount/dismount/ride/saddle have no handler branches at all.

Manual verification steps:
1. Approach a water passage requiring swim/dive and check contextual actions and PlanGrounding.
2. Run `mount horse` / `ride horse` / `dismount` in action execution.
   - expected: swim/dive appear in ActionVerbs and way hints; mount/dismount/ride execute mounted traversal/state cleanly instead of echoing as emotes.
